title: Superficial intelligence
hook_before: Florida Catholic Media points out our growing reliance on superficial intelligence.
script:
Florida Catholic Media warns our growing reliance on superficial intelligence.
Algorithms give fast answers but skip moral reasoning.
We risk trading deep human wisdom for automated summaries.
Can algorithms ever truly understand the human soul?
